summary: The compact one-storey form and shallow hipped roof are recognizable, but the principal entrance is on the wrong face and the model’s brick-and-shingle treatment misses the cabin’s defining material character.

orientation.summary: SV1 is located southwest of the target and looks northeast; on the nearest target cabin, the white door is visible in the broad, camera-facing southwest wall, corresponding to -v (233° outward), not the southeast -u face. The four-face sheet and actual inventory instead place the sole door on -u and a window on -v. There is no duplicate portal, but the principal entry must be moved to -v.

issues.problem: The only entrance is modeled on -u, while located SV1 supports the principal door on -v.
issues.fix: Move the white door and steps from -u to the -v southwest face, preserving a single principal portal; relocate the conflicting -v window as needed.

issues.problem: The model uses red brick walls and a tiled/shingled roof, whereas SV1 shows brown shingle-clad walls and a pale standing-seam metal roof with generous eaves.
issues.fix: Replace the brick texture with coarse brown shingle siding and simplify the roof into pale metal panels with visible seams and broader eaves.
